\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{neurips_2026}

\title{Evidence-Gated Pathology Foundation Model}

\begin{document}

\section{Introduction}

We evaluated our model on a cohort of N=500 prostate cancer slides,
achieving an AUROC=0.92 on Gleason grading and 87.3% accuracy on
ISUP grade classification.

\section{Methods}

We used Phikon-v2 backbone with 0.734 feature correlation to tissue
architecture, validated on N=50 pilot slides with 95.2% precision.

\section{Results}

The model achieved AUC 0.881 on the validation set and showed
0.512 F1 score on the held-out test cohort (N=30).

\end{document}
